question: Some people think that the education system should only focus on preparing students for employment, while others believe it has other important functions. Discuss both sides and then give your own opinion.

row:
1. Be careful to focus on each side clearly and in each of the
body paragraphs. You did not do this well in paragraph 3
2. Also in paragraph 3 you should deal with each of your main
ideas separately rather than lumping them together in all your
sentences.
3. get your opinion in at the start of the conclusion
